While revenue and net income have increased, the concerning decrease in shareholders' equity and a substantial increase in liabilities are major drawbacks. The company's improved operational performance (positive operating income and net income) is offset by its increasing financial leverage and declining equity base.  The confidence score is moderate because the improved profitability is overshadowed by structural problems with equity. A deeper dive into the drivers of the equity decline is crucial.
